items.title: The U.S. Has Been Striking Iran as Trump Talks Up a Deal
items.summary: Trump posted that oil was crashing because Iran wants peace, then US officials said American jets had just struck Iranian territory. The two stories cannot both be true, and oil traders are now betting on which one to believe.
